description: The file defines the internal class GrainRuntime which implements the IGrainRuntime interface. It contains methods and properties for managing grain activation, deactivation, storage, and runtime context verification within the Orleans distributed application framework.

classes.name: GrainRuntime
classes.description: Implements the core runtime functionalities for grains, including activation, deactivation, storage access, and context validation within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Requests deactivation of the specified grain context when idle, with a reason indicating application request.

methods.name: DelayDeactivation
methods.description: Delays the deactivation of a grain for a specified time span, supported only if the grain context implements ICollectibleGrainContext.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the grain's storage object for a specified grain state type, creating a StateStorageBridge to bridge the storage interface.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeContext
methods.description: Verifies that the provided grain context is valid and active, throwing exceptions otherwise.
